title: Cross-Asset Probabilistic FX Forecasting & Market Analysis
author: Humble_Research_708
selftext:
I’ve been working on a cross-asset framework for interpreting probabilistic FX forecasts.

The main idea is that a currency pair should not be analysed in isolation. The framework combines directional and range forecasts with relative currency strength, equities, volatility, government yields, metals and broader risk appetite.

I’m also evaluating every completed forecast in a forward-testing process and tracking direction accuracy, range coverage and prediction error.

For those who use systematic or macro-based approaches, which cross-asset inputs do you find most useful for FX?
